calibration.reason: The frozen ticket says brand or product context may refine or append to seeds and calls it an optional enhancement.
The ticket explicitly permits display in the field or as removable chips; either testable visible result satisfies the stated behavior.
The retained ticket has attachment metadata but no frozen visual bytes, and the pinned source does not establish the claimed preservation rule.
The ticket names a context whose mapping is not selected by the frozen source, so an engineer would have to guess the observable feature mapping.
The pinned search client forwards the provider response order without a local ordering control, while the ticket excludes a provider/API change.
The required fallback uses an undefined few-results threshold and does not select a deterministic narrowing order.
The ticket requires tuning without a code change but does not choose a deploy-time, runtime, or remote configuration owner.
